findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:116 and Roots.lean:55 both use `simp only [signCount_eq_fiberCount, fiberCount_pos, funext_iff, ...]`; grep for `signCount_pos` in the PR yields no hit.
findings.fix: Add `theorem signCount_pos (Z Q σ) : 0 < signCount Z Q σ ↔ ∃ x ∈ Z, ∀ j, sign ((Q j).eval x) = σ j` (proof: `simp only [signCount_eq_fiberCount, fiberCount_pos, funext_iff, Subtype.exists, exists_prop]`) and derive `fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` and `signCount_roots_pos` from it.
findings.issue: `signCount` has only its restatement; there is no `signCount_pos` elimination lemma. Both consumers in the PR re-derive it by unfolding through `fiberCount` (`fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` at Polynomial.lean:111, `signCount_roots_pos` at Roots.lean:50), and any downstream Thom/BKR pruning step will have to do the same.

findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/RealAlgebraicGeometry/README.md:105-112 gives the count-difference definition and names `tarskiQuery p q`; Roots.lean:28 docstring states 'with value zero when `p = 0`' with no corresponding lemma; Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Roots.lean:70-71 `@[simp] theorem roots_zero : (0 : R[X]).roots = 0`; grep `sum_sign|sign_sum` in Mathlib finds no count-difference lemma to reuse.
findings.fix: Add `signSum_eq_card_sub_card (Z p) : signSum Z p = (#{x ∈ Z | 0 < p.eval x} : ℤ) - #{x ∈ Z | p.eval x < 0}` and its specialisation `tarskiQuery_eq_card_sub_card`; add `@[simp] theorem tarskiQuery_zero_left (q) : tarskiQuery 0 q = 0` (one line via `Polynomial.roots_zero`).
findings.issue: `tarskiQuery` exposes only `tarskiQuery_eq_signSum`, which reduces to a subtype sum of signs. The roadmap defines the object as `#{x : p(x)=0 ∧ q(x)>0} - #{x : p(x)=0 ∧ q(x)<0}`, and the Sturm–Tarski target (#9411) must prove equality with that count form; no lemma states it. The header and docstring document a zero-polynomial convention (`tarskiQuery 0 q = 0`) that also has no lemma.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Finset/Card.lean:78 `@[simp, grind =] lemma card_pos : 0 < #s ↔ s.Nonempty`; Fiber.lean:28 carries no attribute.
findings.issue: `fiberCount_pos` is the normal-form positivity characterisation of the new definition but is not `@[simp]`, unlike the Mathlib lemma it wraps; `simp` cannot discharge `0 < fiberCount obs σ` goals without unfolding.

summary: No compatibility layer, nothing hidden as private, bodies unexposed, and the inverse identities are now simp. The characteristic API is still incomplete: `signCount` lacks its elimination lemma, `tarskiQuery` lacks the roadmap's count-difference form and a lemma for its documented zero convention, and `fiberCount_pos` should carry `@[simp]`.
